profile.headline: Software Developer @ Apple
profile.summary: I am Joshua Davis, I am a IOS native application developer with experienced knowledge with SwiftUI and UIKit. I also am skilled at creating a backends with python using using technologies such as FastAPI and PostgreSQL. As well, I am also interested in distributed systems and have experience with Kubernetes.

positions.title: Independent iOS App Developer
positions.description: I create anything from productivity to game applications with multiple apps on the App Store. 4 Apps on the App Store, 10000+ Downloads.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Developed the Landing Page, Task Viewer, and Document List Views for Florence’s IOS application using SwiftUI, Combine, and CombineFeedback
* Integrated with Florence's backend APIs by creating endpoints with Alamofire to download reports
* Created code generation scripts with Sourcery to generate boilerplate for screens and auto-initialize dependencies
* Using Mustache templating language modified existing scripts to generate Swift API from JSON with OpenAPI specification
positions.insights: Skills: Xcode · Swift (Programming Language) · SwiftUI · iOS Development
